findings.location: <article> — paragraph 5 ("While I paused in quiet reminiscence...")
findings.source_quote: As I paused in quiet reminiscence, I was surprised by all the things that have changed in the 40-plus years that I can recall from memory.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the phrase "in un tranquillo rimpianto" with wording that conveys reflection/memory rather than regret. For example: "Mentre mi fermavo in un tranquillo momento di riflessione, sono rimasto sorpreso da tutte le cose che sono cambiate nei più di 40 anni che posso ricordare." This preserves the original sense of quiet remembrance rather than regret. Keep the surrounding sentence structure and HTML tags unchanged.
